tasks.gr12-de-klerk-reforms-and-unbanning-t3: Topic: De Klerk reforms and unbanning. Cover F.W. de Klerk's rise in 1989, the influence of the end of the Cold War, the 2 February 1990 speech, the unbanning of the ANC, PAC, and SACP, Nelson Mandela's release, and the reasons the National Party turned to negotiation. Ask Grade 12 learners to analyse turning points and causation.
tasks.gr12-codesa-and-negotiated-settlement-t3: Topic: CODESA and the negotiated settlement. Cover CODESA I and II, the main constitutional debates, deadlock over power-sharing and majority rule, the impact of violence, the Record of Understanding, the Multi-Party Negotiating Forum, and the interim constitution that led to the 1994 election. Ask Grade 12 learners to explain compromise in transitions.
tasks.gr12-political-violence-and-transition-t: Topic: Political violence and transition. Cover violence in KwaZulu-Natal and Gauteng, conflict involving ANC and Inkatha supporters, hostel violence, allegations of a third force, right-wing resistance, major flashpoints such as Boipatong, Bisho, and the Chris Hani assassination, and how leaders kept the transition from collapse. Ask Grade 12 learners to connect violence and negotiation.
tasks.gr12-1994-election-and-the-trc-t3: Topic: 1994 election and the TRC. Cover the first democratic election on 27 April 1994, the role of the IEC, Mandela's presidency, the Government of National Unity, the goals and methods of the Truth and Reconciliation Commission, Desmond Tutu's role, conditional amnesty, and debates about justice and reconciliation. Ask Grade 12 learners to evaluate outcomes.
